title: Procurement Item
description: One item to be sourced, one-per-Asset-Request. Matches public.procurement_items. Description/Category/Quantity/UnitCost were dropped from this table in migration 0038 -- the linked Asset Request already carries a title/description and a single estimated cost; this table is the sourcing-process record layered on top (mode, requisition, status), not a second copy of the spec.

modeId.description: FK -> lookup_options.id, list_key = 'procurement_mode' (Public Bidding, Simplified, Shopping). Nullable in the DB; the app form requires it before an item can be assigned to a Requisition (migration 0048).

estimatedTotalCost.description: Copied from the linked Asset Request's estimatedCost (migration 0035/0038), which itself may follow a linked BOM. Not independently entered here.

requisitionId.description: FK -> procurement-plan/purchase-requisition.id. Nullable -- an item can exist before it's grouped into a Requisition; on_delete set null (migration 0047). Set from the Purchase Requisition's own reverseLookup editor, not this entity's form (migration 0053).

unitOfMeasure.description: Genuinely varies per item (each/hour/licence/kg/m/lot) with no single correct default -- made nullable rather than defaulted when removed from the app form (migration 0053). May be unset on items created after that migration.

currency.description: DB-defaulted to 'PHP' (migration 0053) -- no longer an app-editable field; every row still gets a non-null value, just not one entered through this entity's form.

specifications.description: Free-form technical requirements (jsonb). Bounded to a flat set of primitive values, not a general nested document store.

statusId.description: FK -> lookup_options.id, list_key = 'procurement_item_status'. No terminal edit-lock (migration 0044 added one, migration 0050 removed it by the user's own call).
